caption:
35 g protein for ₹100: boneless mutton fry recipe, ready in 30 minutes 💪🐐 మటన్ వేపుడు

Save this weeknight recipe 👇
🛒 You need: 500 g goat boneless · 1 onion, sliced · 2 green chillies · a sprig of curry leaves · 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste · ½ tsp turmeric · 1½ tsp red chilli powder · 1 tsp mutton masala · salt · 3 tbsp oil · pepper + coriander to finish
1️⃣ Pressure-cook the mutton with turmeric, salt and ginger-garlic paste: 3–4 whistles.
2️⃣ Heat oil in an iron kadai, fry curry leaves, chillies and onion till golden.
3️⃣ Add the cooked mutton, chilli powder and masala.
4️⃣ Fry on high 8–10 minutes till dry and dark brown.
5️⃣ Finish with pepper and coriander. Serve with rice or rotte.

Goat meat from our own goat farms, at your door in Hyderabad in 60–90 minutes. Never frozen, cut fresh every day.
📊 Per 100 g raw goat meat: protein 20.6 g, iron 2.8 mg, vitamin B12 1.1 µg (Source: USDA FoodData Central)
